description: Stop Overthinking Music | Slow Sarod | 1.5 Hours of Indian Classical Music to quiet a mind that won't switch off.

When your thoughts keep looping, let the sarod slow them down. Ninety minutes of deep, unhurried sarod in Raga Darbari Kanada — grounding, low, and steadying — made to play in the background while you let the mental noise settle, breathe, and stop chasing every thought at the end of the day.
No ads breaking the calm. Just continuous Indian classical music to ease overthinking and an overactive mind.
Best for: overthinking · a racing mind · evening wind-down · anxiety relief · letting the day go.
Put it on, let your shoulders drop, and let the thoughts slow down. 🌙
suno_prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals, no humming — deep gentle Indian classical sarod in Raga Darbari Kanada, resonant plucked sarod with slow meend glides and grounding low register, soft light tabla, unhurried ~62 BPM, settling calming evening character, seamless loop.
